inspection.scope: All SectionII.A mass-origin examples and explicit SectionIII origin-agnostic EFT.
inspection.coverage_note: These are passages and model-definition sections actually inspected, not a claim that every sentence on each page or the entire PDF was read. Field claims are retained separately in field-evidence.json; legacy records remain unchecked reference material.

claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

Pre-breaking Higgs realization is SM plus hidden U1 and one charged complex SM-singlet S; charge conjugation Xprime -> -Xprime,S -> S* stabilizes the vector. No other hidden charged fields in this example. Its single nonzero charge magnitude is removable by the chosen local-algebra generator unit: choose S positive and qS=1. This is an explicit atlas coordinate choice, NOT a printed source numeric charge or global-form assertion.

Stueckelberg phi transforms by an affine shift, not a finite-dimensional linear charge irrep. Two examples give field-dependent masses through SM Higgs or hidden real S; S cannot stand in for the eaten shift field. Do not encode the axion as a neutral ordinary scalar and call inventory complete.

Phenomenological Eq18 takes the massive real vector X, its Z2 and Higgs portal as an EFT, explicitly agnostic to mass origin. Under the SM-only symmetry of this effective description, X is real singlet Lorentz vector; this is separate from the pre-breaking U1 connection in the Higgs realization.

review_scope_note: Source definitions actually checked in earlier pass are reused; not represented as a fresh independent review or whole-paper reread. This additive follow-up supplies exact legacy container IDs and current real-module normalization.
